title: Cycle-time record (v1)
description: One line of history/cycle-times.jsonl, written automatically on every delivered event. Raw and fine-grained; models stay coarse — any future model can be built from raw history retroactively, the reverse is impossible. PRIVACY: per-person, so it never leaves the private data repo and no adapter may render it (cadence-spec.md §11). Source: cadence-spec.md §5.4.

forecast_p50_days.description: The forecast at start time, kept for forecast-vs-actual deltas (adaptation loop, spec §8). Absent if the item was never forecast (e.g. logged pre-Cadence).

preempted_days.description: Days lost to displacement while in flight — lets the forecaster separate execution time from thrash.
